To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a novel graft copolymers, HEC‐g ‐PDMAEMA was synthesized by using Ce(IV) initiator in aqueous solution and used as physical coatings to achieve the separation of basic, acidic, egg white proteins, and milk powder samples.

the HEC-g-PDMAEMA graft copolymeric coatings have great potential for the separation of proteins in CE, and the EOF of the coated capillaries can be modulated by adjusting not only the pH value of the running buffer but also the graft copolymer grafting ratio.
HEC‐g ‐PDMAEMA grafts could be used as physically adsorbing coatings for capillary electropheoresis, which can be applied to the separation of basic and acidic analytes in the same capillaries.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a novel approach to prepare the physically coated capillary with HEC‐g ‐PDMAEMA graft polymer.
the preparation, characterization, and application of the HEC‐graft‐PDMAEMA physical coatings of bare fused‐silicon capillaries.
the synthesis of a novel HEC‐g ‐ PDMAEMA graft copolymers and the use of the copolymer as physically adsorbing coatings of bare fused‐silicon capillary.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the HEC graft copolymer with PDMAEMA grafts is a promising coating for the separation of basic and acidic analytes in CE.
the HEC graft‐PDMAEMA coatings could provide a simple and efficient approach for the separation of proteins by capillary electrophoretic methods.
the synthesized HEGDMA‐g‐PDMDA copolymer‐modified capillaries are very promising for the analysis of basic proteins.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the HEC graft copolymer with a high grafting ratio of PDMAEMA can be used as a physical coating for the separation of basic and acidic analytes in the same capillaries.
the HEC backbone could provide the mechanical strength and the PDMAEMA grafts could endow the coating with the ability to control EOF.
the synthesized HEG‐g‐PDMEAMA graft copolymer could be used as an effective and versatile physical coating to suppress EOF for the separation of proteins.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the synthesized graft copolymer HEC‐g ‐PDMAEMA can be used as a physical coating for capillary electropheoresis to achieve efficient separation of proteins.
the HEC graft copolymers can be used as the physical coating of the capillary for CE separation of basic proteins.
HEC‐gPDMAEMA can be used as a novel physical coating for CE.
